Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Name: Sham Trust
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Chimestry
[chi] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[CHI] Only usable when a bleed action against you would be successful. You do not burn more than 1 pool, regardless of the amount of the bleed. Put this card on the acting minion. Any vampire you control may burn this card to deal 2 damage on that minion as a +1 stealth  action.

Art note: a Ravnos vampire in the foreground is spying from a street corner another vampire entering a office building by night. From the viewer's perspective, the office building front look like a huge illusional section of wall abut a small mini-market with an old man behind the counter.

WoD source: Chimestry is used to create illusion that lure vampires away from their real goal.

Compelling game needs: Bleed reduction doesn't work because it's too weak and you'll probably better just use bounce which combine defense and offense.
I'm trying here to create an equivalent alternative in a discipline that don't have access to bleed defense.

Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Klaital
Messages.Body: That card should cost a blood, its way too good for a free card, Chimerstry has very few free cards. Also the superior should have 'a minion can have only one Sham Trust' text added. And also the superior should read 'You still control this card' as otherwise its that persons vampires who could burn it.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
> Klaital wrote:
> Chimerstry has very few free cards.
>
It's why it should be free for me. The average cost of chimestry card is already a bit over one blood. If the card is too powerful, it should be made weaker but still free, not the other way around.

On another note, changing the superior to burn blood instead of doing damage would already be a significant nerf. I suppose it's damage in order to better punish Villein abuse.

"Unique" on the superior effect would make the card limited to once per turn in effect, since all bleed would happen before you have a chance to burn it. "A minion can have only one Sham Trust" would be a more gentle nerf

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
Well, there are quite a lot of good suggestions there. I switched from "burn blood" to damage before posting the final version because it was too weak to be worth an action. Steal blood would be better than "burn blood" but still weaker than dealing damage which is more a real threat.
Limiting it to 1 per minion will force the player to take advantage of it as soon as possible (=before the next big bleed) which is a good thing.

Name: Sham Trust
Cardtype: Reaction
Discipline: Chimestry
[chi] Reduce a bleed against you by 1.
[CHI] Only usable when a bleed action against you would be successful. You do not burn more than 1 pool, regardless of the amount of the bleed. Put this card on the acting minion. You still control this card. Any vampire you control may burn this card to deal 2 damage on that minion as a +1 stealth  action. A minion can have only one Sham Trust.
